verdict: Six single-walker 1-us WTMetaD runs (sigma 0.35 rad, H 1.2 kJ/mol, gamma 10, PACE 500) are not converged: dG(S3-S1) is non-monotonic in T and jumps by >10 kJ/mol between neighbouring temperatures; each run remains trapped in the S1- or S3-dominated branch it fell into during the first ~100-200 ns. No transition temperature is derived from them. Multiple-walker or OPES sampling is the pending fix.
